intro.text: A city-state on Roshar's eastern coast, the easiest gateway to the Shattered Plains, and home of the blue-skinned Natan.

description.text: The Natan have pale blue skin, woolly white hair and wide noses. Some dye a few locks of hair in vivid colours, and their names have common and high forms: Au-nak's high form is Nak-ali.
The Natan are mostly Vorin, but also revere the moons, especially Nomon, so some Alethi ardents consider them almost pagan.
Caravans run between the city and the Alethi warcamps on the Shattered Plains, so the Natan keep an ambassador in the warcamps to court the Alethi lighteyes.
New Natanan is the largest city on the Ocean of Origins. Ships stop there to rest and resupply, and it reports each new highstorm as it makes landfall.

items.text: The region was once part of the Silver Kingdom of Natanatan. As that kingdom slowly fell apart, it shrank to a single settlement: New Natanan.
Before the war on the Shattered Plains, Dalinar led a small force through the city to claim the Plains. Jasnah and Shallan's ship was sunk on its way there.
New Natanan was the first major city struck by the Everstorm, despite Dalinar and Navani's warning.
When Dalinar invited them into his coalition, the Natan played for time, and joined only after Taravangian brought in Jah Keved and Kharbranth.
The Natan claim the Oathgate at Stormseat as heirs of ancient Natanatan, but lack the power to enforce it.
